config.selection: Preselected seen programs: four distinct training families with real S0/S1 actions; two separate validation families. No selection by new timings. No test programs.

behavior.nonadvance: uniform structural stratum (kind, enclosing function, loop depth, callee), then uniform member

training.batch: one seeded-cycled trajectory per training program per update, equal family then program then trajectory; common schedule across models
training.selection: fixed-final-200; no validation-based tuning or extra seed

config.limits: No new actions, tree enumeration, unchosen-action labels, ranking loss, RL, tuning, test domain, hashes or historical matrix. Default is a reference only. S2 has no q supervision.

data_audit.scope: Targets only for sampled S0/S1 actions; defaults excluded from training; no ranking/counterfactual labels or new test domain.

prefixes.interpretation: sampled conditional suffix outcomes, not complete factorial or noise-free causal interaction

coverage.scope: Read-only sampled-rollout coverage; effects descriptive only, no counterfactual ranking labels. Timing MAD is not the MC suffix variance.

replay.scope: Fresh process; actual joint non-advance path; only run labels/unused environment fields differ; no native performance timing.

train.scope: Posthoc descriptive constant root-cost prediction, not an added fitted model or compiler run.

validation.scope: Posthoc descriptive constant root-cost prediction, not an added fitted model or compiler run.

integration.scope: Private checkpoint copies and one injected/stale branch; no extra performance labels or model fitting.

cache_audit.scope: Direct bytes of old campaign/recovered data and old/new weights, metadata and old SDK binaries; no hashes, extra fitting or native matrix.

recipe.scope: Bounded compatibility only, not train/validation/test or a performance label
